category_edits.rationale: For all four datasets, replace single-negative BPR with full-catalog cross-entropy averaged equally over existing masked target positions. Catalog-wide competition may improve ranking discrimination. Preserve sampling, model architecture, tied embeddings, inference, optimizer and training settings.

change_summary: Replace BPR with full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy across all four datasets. Padding and the exclusive mask token are excluded from output classes; checkpoint shapes and predictor remain compatible.
